assets.prompt: BRINE underwater station-builder terrain material, square fully opaque texture edge to edge. Direct overhead orthographic view of submerged fine grey-beige sand with subtle current-made ripple marks. Broad quiet low contrast mineral surface. Very shallow SHORT broken gently bowed ripple segments, roughly horizontal with natural interruptions and irregular spacing, sand between them. No long continuous lines across entire canvas, no bold zebra bands, no chevrons, no checkerboard. Muted warm grey mineral palette, sparse fine dark grains, restrained tactile detailed game art. Soft neutral diffuse lighting, barely visible trough shading. Ripples should remain secondary to station structures at four room cells per texture width. No pebbles, shells, plants, debris, bubbles, footprints, cracks, blue water wash, wet specular highlights, central focal object, horizon, vignette, border or text. Even distribution and matching edge character for repeated world sampling. This is a quiet seabed ground material, not a photographed beach landscape.
